Jane - Customer: Hi, we had a 48h default retention on a dev dataset that expired 3 hours ago but several objects still show up in the Search UI. customer_id=acme-42. Can you confirm delete completed on your end? :eyes:
Alex S.: Sorry about that — can you paste a quick repro? object ids or a query sample will help.
Jane - Customer: Query: `GET /v1/search?q=user_id:321&type=embedding` -> returns 12 hits including id `obj_9b2f`. But direct storage check `GET /v1/objects/obj_9b2f` returns 404. UI is definitely showing it. Screenshot attached.
Alex S.: Interesting — storage tombstoned but search index still surfaced it. Can you confirm whether you used a custom retention or default?
Jane - Customer: Default retention. No legal hold. We didn't set preserve.
Alex S.: Thanks. I'm going to escalate — pinging @Maya (oncall) and infra. RetentionBot, any recent policy changes for acme-42? :thinking:
RetentionBot: Policy update: no custom TTL changes in last 7 days for acme-42. Last policy apply job: job_id=job-8821 finished at 1748790000.
Maya (oncall): @Alex S. sending repro steps to eng: can you share the exact API call (curl) you used and the raw response payload for the search hit? small logs help.
Alex S.: Paste from customer: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.cloud/v1/search?q=user_id:321&type=embedding" | jq '.hits[] | select(.id=="obj_9b2f")'```
Alex S.: Raw hit shows: `{"id":"obj_9b2f","score":0.92,"_source":{"visible":true}}` while storage head returns 404.
Tom I. (infra): Oncall check: indexer processes sometimes surface stale results if indexer rehydrations or replays are in-flight. I see a reindex batch for region-us-east that started at 1748796000 and had some transient failures. Can we get the indexer job logs for that timeframe?
Maya (oncall): @Tom I. can you check whether the indexer replay included tombstone handling? We have a TTL tombstone removal marker that should remove index entries. If the tombstone event wasn't consumed, search will still return.
Tom I. (infra): Looking into logs: indexer consumer for shard-13 logged `ERR: transient connection reset` at 1748796034 and retried. Consumer ack shows processing of tombstone events resumed at 1748797200. There's a window ~19min where tombstone could be missed from index. However our at-least-once guarantees should re-deliver — need to check backlog.
Alex S.: Noted. Also customer reports the UI still shows the object; we might need to evict cache on the search layer. Can we run a targeted index delete for obj_9b2f?
Tom I. (infra): Yes, we can run `POST /internal/indexes/evict` with body `{"ids":["obj_9b2f"]}` but that requires ops approval.
Maya (oncall): Approving targeted evict for this thread. @Tom I. please proceed and paste the command/results.
Tom I. (infra): Running now: ```POST /internal/indexes/evict {"ids":["obj_9b2f"]} -> 202 Accepted, evict_task=evict-1748801500```
DeployBot: Evict task evict-1748801500 started on cluster-us-east.
Tom I. (infra): Evict finished: 200 OK, evicted_count=1. Search replicas invalidated.
Alex S.: Jane, can you refresh the UI and confirm it's gone?
Jane - Customer: Refreshing... I can confirm obj_9b2f is gone now. Thanks. But will this happen again? We have a couple thousand expired objects and this is urgent for compliance.
Maya (oncall): Short term: we evicted the stale entry. Long term: we need to root cause why tombstone events weren't applied during the reindex window. Tom, can you open a retention-indexer backlog ticket and attach offsets for that shard?
Tom I. (infra): Opening ticket INFRA-4729 with offsets and logs. Preliminary root cause: transient consumer disconnect during reindex; replay eventually caught up but some edge-case ordering with rehydrate job caused index to be re-populated from a stale snapshot.
Ash L. (Legal): Quick Q: did customer request any legal hold or preservation during this window? If legal hold was requested we need to preserve originals.
Jane - Customer: No legal hold. We actually need the data gone for an upcoming audit.
Alex S.: Action items for us: 1) Provide Jane with auditlog slice for object lifecycle (timestamps: deletion request, tombstone creation, index delete, evict) 2) Confirm KMS activity during deletion window (any key rotation that could affect tombstone visibility) 3) Permanent fix: ensure indexer replay handles tombstone-after-rehydrate ordering.
Maya (oncall): I'll take 1 and 2. Tom will take 3.
Maya (oncall): @Tom I. can you also check whether a KMS rotation happened around 1748796000? Key rotations sometimes cause brief metadata unavailability which can affect consumers.
Tom I. (infra): Checking KMS audit: rotation for key `cust-acme-42` happened at 1748795900. There was a brief HSM throttle at 1748795925 returning 429 to crypto proxy. That aligns with the indexer consumer disconnect. Could be related.
Alex S.: Good catch. Maya, please include KMS audit lines in the bundle to customer.
Maya (oncall): Will do. Also recommending customer: run a `preserve:create` if they need to stop purges, otherwise not necessary. Jane, since you need deletion for audit, we can: a) provide confirmation of hard delete events and evict log, b) run a scoped reindex to ensure no more stale hits for your tenant, c) coordinate a manual full verification run. Which do you prefer?
Jane - Customer: Please do a scoped reindex of our tenant and the full verification run. We want certificate/logs for audit.
Alex S.: Noted. @Tom I. please schedule scoped reindex for acme-42 and produce verification report. Use priority P1 since this is compliance/audit.
Tom I. (infra): Scheduling scoped reindex job reindex-acme-1748802000 -> queued. Will post job id when started.
RetentionBot: Scoped reindex scheduled: reindex-acme-1748802000, priority=P1.
Tom I. (infra): Reindex started at 1748802400, ingest consumers healthy. I'll run verification after completion and attach the report here.
Maya (oncall): Closing loop checklist: 1) targeted evict done 2) KMS audit attached (myaudit_export_1748802600) 3) scoped reindex in progress 4) verification pending -> after that we'll send official compliance note.
Alex S.: Jane, we'll deliver the audit bundle and verification report once reindex completes. Sorry for the disruption — will follow up in this thread. :handshake:
Jane - Customer: Thanks everyone. Appreciated the quick turnaround.
Tom I. (infra): Reindex finished at 1748802800. Verification run: scanned 12k expired ids -> 0 stale index hits remaining. Report: verification-acme-1748802800 attached.
Alex S.: Sending final bundle now.
Jane - Customer: Got the bundle, everything looks good. Closing on my side.
Maya (oncall): Marking this thread resolved. Root cause: transient HSM/KMS throttle led to indexer consumer disconnect during rehydrate -> race with snapshot re-population. Follow-ups: INFRA-4729, RETAIN-881 (indexer ordering fix).
Alex S.: Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
